scope: Non-operational computational analysis of de-identified public viral trajectory data. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, or clinical recommendation.

allowed_preinspection_information: README states measurements are longitudinal SARS-CoV-2 Ct trajectories
time is indexed relative to each person's minimum Ct
the publication studied acute viral dynamics
forbidden_until_freeze_complete: inspection of target CSV row values

target_replication.role: independent related cohort/variant replication after primary scoring

core_object.name: MIRROR_FIRST_BREAK_INDEX
core_object.definition: For each subject aligned at day 0 = minimum Ct, construct matched observations at equal absolute day offsets on the pre-peak and post-peak arms. For offset d, define mirror residual R_i(d)=Ct_i(+d)-Ct_i(-d). Aggregate only subjects with both sides observed at that d.
core_object.first_break: The smallest positive integer offset d for which the preregistered population-level mirror-asymmetry criterion passes; otherwise NONE/UNKNOWN.
core_object.interpretation: FIRST_BREAK localizes where the rising and falling trajectories cease to be mirror-compatible at the observable Ct resolution; it does not identify a molecular cause by itself.

primary_hypothesis.H1: Acute SARS-CoV-2 Ct trajectories are not mirror-symmetric around their within-person minimum Ct; a reproducible FIRST_BREAK exists on the early offsets rather than only as a global duration difference.
primary_hypothesis.directional_prediction: At the first robust break, median R(d) is expected to be negative, corresponding to slower post-peak clearance than pre-peak approach to peak viral burden.
primary_hypothesis.novelty_status_before_analysis: UNKNOWN; exact first-break observable must undergo post-result prior-art search.

scoring_rule.criterion: FIRST_BREAK at earliest d with n_matched>=10, absolute median(R_i(d))>=1.0 Ct, and two-sided exact sign-test p<=0.01 against median zero. No multiple-comparison relaxation; offsets are tested sequentially and the first passing boundary is reported.
secondary_outputs: distribution of per-subject arm slopes where estimable
scoring_rule.missingness: No interpolation for primary endpoint. Missing mirror partner means subject is excluded only at that offset.

replication_rule.pass: Replication has a FIRST_BREAK in the same direction within plus/minus 2 offset days of the primary FIRST_BREAK, with no threshold changes.
replication_rule.fail: No qualifying break, opposite direction, or break differs by more than 2 days.
replication_rule.unknown: Insufficient matched observations under frozen eligibility.

negative_control.name: WITHIN_DATASET_SIDE_LABEL_PERMUTATION_NULL
negative_control.construction: For each matched subject-offset pair, independently randomize which member is called pre versus post, preserving absolute Ct pair values and missingness. Repeat conceptually as an exact sign-flip null for R_i(d).
negative_control.requirement: Observed first-break evidence must not be reproducible under the side-symmetric null; the exact sign test is the frozen analytic implementation of this control.

causal_isolation_firewall: The primary and replication cohorts are not automatically independent if they share participants, laboratories, or processing lineage; inspect provenance before calling replication independent.
Selection on having both pre/post observations can act as a collider; report eligible counts and do not generalize beyond the sampled cohort without a missingness analysis.
Ct mirror asymmetry is an observable trajectory property, not proof of immune mechanism, infectivity, or treatment effect.
Time index is treated as ordering/offset, not as a causal antiviral agent.

required_after_hit: post-result prior-art null for the exact observable
material consequence beyond already-known rise/decline asymmetry
second virus or mechanistically distinct dataset if claiming a general law

anti_retrospective_rule: If target raw values were inspected before this commit, mark the experiment contaminated. Otherwise this commit is the freeze receipt for the declared scoring rule.
